changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.19[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Easynews: more results[/COLOR]
-Searches ask Easynews for up to 1000 files at once instead of 250.
-Movies are searched by title, and the year is checked afterwards allowing one year either side. Releases named with the year before or after were never found before.
-Titles with an apostrophe are found: "Grey's Anatomy" is searched as "Greys Anatomy", the way releases are named.
-Up to 200 Easynews results are listed instead of 80.
-The manual search in the Easynews menu finds the same files as the source search.
-Playback opens Easynews' download server directly, so the username and password are no longer part of the link Kodi plays and no longer appear in the Kodi log. If that is not possible, the file plays as before.
[COLOR fffdb515]Easynews: Account Info and logo[/COLOR]
-Account Info now tells a wrong username or password apart from Easynews not being reachable, instead of always showing "Error retrieving EasyNews Account Info".
-When the login is right but Easynews' account page does not show its usual table, the window still opens, confirms the login and shows the plan and usage details it can read.
-Easynews shows its official logo in its menu and notifications, in Settings > Accounts, in the account status window and in Sync your devices.
[COLOR fffdb515]Fixes[/COLOR]
-Preview: the trailer no longer seems to play twice when Preview is opened from a skin widget. Many skins show the playing video behind their windows, and it showed through the dimmed background. While the trailer loads and plays, the background is now solid with the title's fanart faint on it. During the countdown the poster wall stays in sight as before.
